title: HOLD H FOR AN ARMOUR PLATE
why: His order of 2026-10-13: hold H for an armour plate, tap H stays the heal, Warzone-style, one key for both. A tap of H quick-heals as it did (now as the key comes up, so a tap takes the few hundredths of a second it is held); holding it for about a third of a second slots an armour plate through the same path the belt uses, so ARMOUR FULL, ALREADY SLOTTING and the rig ceiling apply, and with no plate it says NO ARMOUR PLATE. A tap never starts a plate and a hold never heals. Putting a plate on also stops playing the old pick chirp: the plate wind-up had no sound of its own, so it kept the chirp at the start and again when it landed; it now plays the armour clack of the foley bank as the plate seats, as the strap pulls tight and when it lands. The controls lists name the hold.
now: Tap H to heal, hold H to slot an armour plate, and a plate now clacks into place instead of chirping.
